Incorporated in April 1974, it is designated as a ''Navratna{{Vague|reason=What is the implication or significance of such a designation?|date=September 2025}}'' Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE). The company provides consultancy, engineering, and project delivery services in the field including railways, highways, metros, tunnels, bridges, urban development, buildings, airports, ports, ropeways, inland waterways, multimodal logistics parks and green mobility.{{Cite web|title=RITES Limited(RITES),Profile, Latest News, Press Release, MOU, CSR|url=https://www.psuconnect.in/company/rites-limited/65|access-date=2020-12-08|website=www.psuconnect.in}} ==History== RITES was established in 1974 to provide consultancy services to the [[Indian Railways]], including feasibility studies, project planning, and infrastructure development. Over the years, its scope expanded to cover other transport sectors and overseas markets.{{cite web|url=http://www.rites.com/web/index.php|title=Home Page|publisher=RITES, Limited|access-date=2011-08-12|archive-date=26 September 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090926125023/http://www.rites.com/web/index.php|url-status=dead}} The company has undertaken more than 5,000 projects in India and over 55 countries across Asia, Africa, and Latin America. In 2018, RITES became a publicly traded company listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and the [[National Stock Exchange of India]].{{Cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/rites-ltd/ipos/isopen-,companyid-18469.cms|title=Rites IPO Review – Rites IPO Dates, Issue Price, Subscription and Allotment Status – The Economic Times|website=economictimes.indiatimes.com|access-date=2020-01-04}} The company has also been involved in the planning and design of high-speed rail networks, dedicated freight corridors, and urban metro systems.{{Cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/markets/rites-gains-6-on-bonus-issue-plan-119061400191_1.html|title=RITES gains 6% to Rs 295 on bonus issue plan announcement|last=Reporter|first=S. I.|date=2019-06-14|work=Business Standard India|access-date=2020-01-04}} == Operations == ===Engineering Design and Project Reports=== RITES' engineering design activities include the [[engineering]] consultancy, feasibility studies, design and planning, environmental assessments, and project management services across multiple sectors. It also prepares detailed project reports, environmental and social impact assessments, and undertakes geotechnical investigations and surveys.{{Cite news |last=Nagasundaram |first=Dhanya |date=2025-02-20 |title=Rites share price jumps 7% after MoU with Central Water and Power Research Station {{!}} Stock Market News |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/rites-share-price-jumps-7-after-mou-with-central-water-and-power-research-station-11740026795661.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250307171343/https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/rites-share-price-jumps-7-after-mou-with-central-water-and-power-research-station-11740026795661.html |archive-date=2025-03-07 |access-date=2025-08-18 |work=mint |language=en}} ===Project Management Services=== The company undertakes project management through advisory services for project appraisal, [[procurement]] assistance, project management consultancy, third‑party inspections and authority engineer roles.{{Cite web |title=RITES Wins $3.4 Million High-Speed Rail Survey Contract |url=https://www.constructionworld.in/transport-infrastructure/metro-rail-and-railways-infrastructure/rites-wins-3.4-million-high-speed-rail-survey-contract/70198 |access-date=2025-08-15 |website=www.constructionworld.in |language=en}} ===Export of Rolling Stock=== It is engaged in the export of rolling stock such as [[locomotive]]s, [[Train coach|coaches]], wagons and other railway equipment, providing commissioning, warranty and spare parts support, incidental services etc.{{Cite web |date=2025-06-25 |title=First Indian-built diesel locomotive by BLW exported to Mozambique |url=https://rollingstockworld.com/locomotives/first-indian-built-diesel-locomotive-by-blw-exported-to-mozambique/ |access-date=2025-08-18 |website=ROLLINGSTOCK}} ===Leasing of Locomotives and O&M of Rail Assets=== RITES operates a fleet of over 90 locomotives provided to non-railway clients, including but not limited to ports, cement plants, coal plants, power plants, container deports, project sites etc. RITES also manages operations and maintenance (O&M) services of rail assets at more than 30 sites across India.{{Cite web |last=www.ETGovernment.com |title=RITES: Fostering the development of sustainable urban habitats and transport systems |url=https://government.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/smart-infra/rites-fostering-planning-development-of-sustainable-urban-habitats-and-transport-systems/110841772 |access-date=2025-08-15 |website=ETGovernment.com |language=en}} ===Turnkey Construction Work=== In turnkey construction, the company executes Engineering, Procurement and Construction contracts covering [[railway electrification]], stations, bridges, tunnels, depots and related facilities.{{Cite web |title=RITES Wins ₹46.82 Crore Turnkey Deal for College Infrastructure Work in Karnataka {{!}} India Infoline
